steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The adult human skeleton is made up of 206 bones . At birth, humans have around 270 bones, but many fuse together as the body grows. | Exam Tip: The pectoral girdle (shoulder) and pelvic girdle (hip) are part of the appendicular skeleton, not the axial. A common mistake is thinking the pelvis belongs to the axial skeleton because it's in the centre of the body. | You must know all five functions: Support, Protection, Movement, Mineral Storage, Blood Cell Production. | The vertebral column: consists of 33 vertebrae stacked on top of each other, separated by intervertebral discs that act as shock absorbers.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Name the five functions of the skeleton. | How many bones make up the axial skeleton? | Give one example each of a long bone, a short bone, a flat bone and an irregular bone.
